name: fmp_stock_screener
description:
Screens listed stocks by market cap, price, beta, volume, dividend, sector, industry, country and exchange with Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/stock-screener).
Returns {criteria, results_count, results}: criteria echoes the filters sent; results lists matching companies.
Inputs (* required): none; all optional. marketCapMoreThan/LowerThan (integer, USD), priceMoreThan/LowerThan, betaMoreThan/LowerThan, volumeMoreThan (integer, shares), dividendMoreThan, sector, industry, country (code, e.g. US), exchange (e.g. NASDAQ), limit (integer; 20 is sent when no filter at all is given).
Valid filter values: fmp_available_sectors, fmp_available_industries, fmp_available_countries, fmp_available_exchanges.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"sector": "Technology", "marketCapMoreThan": 10000000000, "exchange": "NASDAQ", "limit": 25}

sector.description: Sector filter (e.g., Technology, Healthcare, Financial Services)
